topic: McGuire homogeneous reciprocal-depth SSR 2D DDA vs screen-space linear-Z hyperbolic ray bowing rig
topic_zh: McGuire 齐次倒数深度 SSR 二维 DDA 步进对比屏幕空间线性 Z 抛物弯曲穿墙
scope: Deterministic Morgan McGuire & Michael Mara (JCGT 2014) homogeneous reciprocal-depth screen-space 2D DDA ray marching (q(u) = (1-u)/z_0 + u/z_1, z(u) = 1/q(u)) versus naive screen-space linear-Z interpolation and 54-step 3D view-space projection inversion across 17 screen-space stations (u in [0.00, 1.00]). No neural reflection inpainting execution.

robustness.name: Sampled 17 screen-space DDA stations preserve exact 3D straight-line depth without hyperbolic bowing

good_fit: Screen-Space Reflections (SSR), Screen-Space GI (SSGI), and contact shadows in UE5, Frostbite, and Unity HDRP
Explaining why interpolating linear depth z linearly in 2D screen space bows a 2m → 34m ray by +14.22m at the screen midpoint
Stepping q_k = q_0 + k·Δq (where q = 1/z) with 1 addition per pixel step during 2D Bresenham/DDA traversal
Eliminating per-step 4×4 perspective matrix multiplications during screen-space ray marching
not_for: Orthographic cameras where perspective division w = z does not occur and z(u) is genuinely linear in screen space
World-space hardware BVH ray tracing (DXR / Vulkan Ray Query) that steps in 3D Euclidean coordinates rather than 2D pixels
Neural reflection hallucination or off-screen inpainting networks
